desc:
Roll the dice with other players and test your luck. After everyone rolls the dice, the bad chances will increase! 

🕹️ There are 5 gamemodes: ⛓️Traps, 🔪Murder, 🔥Cursed, 🌪️Chaos and 💀Classic!

💰 Collect coins to buy skins or enable the ☠️Hardcore Mode 

⚠️ Wins do not count and do not grant coins on VIP servers; however, you can still earn coins in other ways

This experience contains soft flashing lights

Some credits: 
Coins icons and thumbnail by Bruno Moreira
